sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics

The game starts off easy, but as the player progresses, the enemies get faster, the screen gets smaller, and the challenge increases exponentially. 

The game's controls are incredibly simple, using either the mouse, keyboard, or touch controls to navigate the character. The player must click on the big point to move their character, and the enemies can be avoided by clicking on the clear space around them. It's a simple yet effective system that requires quick reflexes and strategic thinking to master.
